name: Errand
description: Errand runs your errands in Naira from your own wallet. You keep USD₮ in your own Altana wallet and grant Errand a session with an onchain spend cap, a list of the only contracts it may call, and an expiry, revocable in one transaction. Errand plans each errand, checks every payment with its guard, converts USD₮ to cNGN on Textile FX, pays the named recipient, and returns a receipt with a Celoscan link for every transaction. Errand Guard (https://errand-guard-celo.onrender.com) lets other agents pay $0.01 USD₮ over x402 to have a Celo payment checked first; Self Agent ID decides which agents get served and how often.
